reasons.plausibility: Heterophase boundary pinning of dislocations is a well-known strengthening mechanism, so the proposal for enhanced creep resistance in a dual-phase FCC/BCC coating is scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The controlled comparison of coatings with refined versus coarser interfaces under identical creep tests provides a clear experimental design to confirm or refute the main claim.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying the role of heterophase interfaces in improving creep performance and providing a direct test to isolate this effect is highly relevant for researchers seeking strategies to enhance high-temperature alloy coatings.
